holdings.name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported over 26% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27 with 20% same-store sales growth, expanding its network to 546 showrooms with 12 Kalyan and 9 Candere showroom launches, while stating debt was zero.
Completed the sale of land in Coimbatore for Rs 86.16 crore on September 30, 2026.
India Ratings reaffirmed bank facility credit ratings at IND AA-/Positive and IND A1+.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kalyan Jewellers is the fund's largest position at 2.87% weight. While its 6-month return was 30.73%, it softened over 3 months (-2.86%), making Q2 execution critical for near-term momentum.

watch.text: Full audited margin and profit figures following the preliminary 26% sales growth update.

holdings.name: Biocon Ltd

what_changed.text: Settled patent litigation with Genentech and Roche over breast cancer drug Pebrilzo, paving the way for EU and UK commercial launch in Q1 2027 and US rollout in Q3 2028.
Received a GST order demanding Rs 1.85 crore in tax, Rs 1.18 crore in interest, and Rs 18.5 lakh in penalty for FY23.
Approved the grant of 94,60,232 stock options at Rs 5 per option under its employee incentive plan.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.47% fund weight, Biocon's -20.13% 3-month return made it the second largest detractor from performance, shaving an estimated -0.497% off the fund.

watch.text: Regulatory progress towards the planned European rollout of Pebrilzo in Q1 CY27.

holdings.name: The Federal Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Approved Q2 FY27 results showing a 45% YoY increase in profit to Rs 1,386 crore, as total business passed Rs 6.4 lakh crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Federal Bank accounts for 2.39% of the portfolio in Financials, which is the fund's biggest sector (24.5%). The stock is up 57.58% over 1 year, despite consolidating with a -3.15% return over 3 months.

watch.text: Sustained loan book expansion and asset quality metrics across its Rs 6.4 lakh crore business franchise.

holdings.name: One 97 Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: NPCI deferred the rollout of merchant discount rates (MDR) on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali.
Subsidiary First Games Technology Private Limited (FGTPL) received a GST demand notice of Rs 703.66 crore plus interest and penalties for FY19 through FY23.
Increased its equity stake in subsidiary Little Internet.
Scheduled a board meeting on October 26, 2026, to review Q2 FY27 financial results.

holdings.why_it_matters: One 97 Communications was the fund's top 3-month contributor (+0.587% contribution, +25.63% return) at a 2.29% fund weight, though regulatory delays on UPI MDR triggered a -5.39% 1-month dip.

watch.text: Developments around the implementation of UPI P2M MDR following Diwali.
Q2 FY27 earnings performance on October 26, 2026, and legal recourse regarding the Rs 703.66 crore GST demand.

holdings.name: IDFC First Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Released provisional Q2 FY27 numbers showing deposit and loan figures along with strong FCNR(B) inflows.
Brickwork reaffirmed its BWR AA+/Stable rating on Rs 406.90 crore of NCDs.
Partnered with Kinetic EV to provide retail financing for electric two-wheelers.
Scheduled its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call for October 24, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.20% portfolio weight in Financials, IDFC First Bank pulled back -8.15% over 1 month and -2.83% over 3 months, weighing on sector contribution.

watch.text: Full audited net interest margins and credit cost trends at the Q2 earnings call on October 24, 2026.

holdings.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd

what_changed.text: Delivered record Q2 FY27 sales volumes of 963,143 tonnes, marking an increase of 13% YoY and 29% QoQ.
Hiked product prices in late September with an additional price increase implemented from October 1, 2026.
Secured shareholder approval at its AGM for a final dividend of Rs 8.50 per share.

holdings.why_it_matters: APL Apollo Tubes holds 2.16% in Industrials and generated a +19.90% 3-month return, adding +0.430% to the fund's return as the third largest gainer.

watch.text: Sustained volume absorption following the consecutive product price increases initiated on October 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Mankind Pharma Ltd.

what_changed.text: Approved the acquisition of a 70% stake in Belgian CAR-T oncology biotech firm Armed Cell Therapeutics (ACTx) for EUR 48 million, plus an additional investment commitment of up to EUR 45 million.
Assigned an ESG rating of 71 for FY26 by NSE Sustainability.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.12% weight, Mankind Pharma forms a core part of the fund's 8.0% Healthcare basket. The stock slid -8.40% over 3 months, mirroring broader drag across the fund's healthcare assets.

watch.text: Regulatory approvals and closing milestones for the 70% ACTx acquisition.

holdings.name: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd

what_changed.text: Recorded Q2 FY27 pre-sales of Rs 7,225 crore (up 20% YoY) and H1 FY27 pre-sales of Rs 13,804.3 crore.
CPPIB closed its first tranche in Prestige Hospitality Ventures, investing Rs 950 crore for a 10% equity stake and Rs 550 crore in compulsory convertible preference shares.
Settled legal disputes on the Turf View project, leading the Bombay High Court to restore de-registration and promoter modifications.

expected.text: Morgan Stanley and Nomura expected lower Q2 pre-sales and collections than the delivered numbers.

seeing.text: Reported Q2 pre-sales reached Rs 7,225 crore, beating broker forecasts.

holdings.why_it_matters: Prestige Estates represents 1.99% of the fund. Despite a -11.87% 3-month return (-0.236% contribution), operational pre-sales beat forecasts and 1-month return recovered +4.78%.

watch.text: Cash collection speed and utilization of the remaining Rs 1,500 crore commitment under the CPPIB hospitality platform.

holdings.name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL assigned an A1+ rating to its proposed Rs 500 crore commercial paper programme.
Disclosed Rs 1,500 crore in outstanding debt securities as of September 30, 2026.
Received an order from CGST Bhuj confirming an input tax credit disallowance demand of Rs 1.05 crore plus an equal penalty for FY23, which the company intends to appeal.

holdings.why_it_matters: Balkrishna Industries accounts for 1.96% in Consumer Discretionary. Performance has stagnated over 3 months (-0.40%) and declined -11.71% over 6 months, limiting fund upside.

watch.text: Issuance and borrowing rates under the newly rated Rs 500 crore commercial paper facility.

holdings.name: Coforge Ltd

what_changed.text: Launched an intent engineering framework designed for enterprise AI agents.
Expanded its Kraków AI engineering centre with targets to grow headcount beyond 660 by 2027.
HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its shareholding in the company to 4.30%.
Scheduled its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call for October 23, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Coforge constitutes 1.91% of the fund and was the second largest positive contributor over 3 months, posting a +29.40% return and contributing +0.562% to fund performance.

watch.text: Revenue growth trajectory and AI-driven order bookings in the Q2 results on October 23, 2026.

portfolio.statement: Franklin India Mid Cap Fund declined -5.14% over 3 months as severe pullbacks in PB Fintech, Biocon, and Swiggy offset notable rallies in One 97 Communications and Coforge.
interp: Heavy sector allocations to Financials (24.5%) and Healthcare (8.0%) created performance divergence, with banking stability contrasting with biosimilar and fintech regulatory pressures.
Industrials (19.7%) and Technology (8.8%) provided the portfolio's top return contributions, aided by record sales volumes at APL Apollo and AI expansion at Coforge.
portfolio.line: Gains in technology and industrial leaders were unable to counterbalance concentrated drag from healthcare, fintech, and real estate holdings.

drivers.text: One 97 Communications gained 25.63%, delivering the highest individual 3-month contribution (+0.587%) to the portfolio.
Coforge appreciated 29.40%, adding +0.562% in estimated 3-month portfolio contribution.
APL Apollo Tubes rose 19.90% (+0.430% contribution) driven by a record 9.63 lakh tonnes in Q2 volume.
Biocon fell -20.13%, detracting -0.497% from fund returns over 3 months.

themes.title: Oncology & Biotechnology Pipeline Expansion
themes.text: Holdings are expanding their specialized therapeutic and biosimilar portfolios through acquisitions and patent settlements.

themes.title: Domestic Retail and Volume Growth
themes.text: Discretionary and industrial leaders are expanding physical networks and booking record volumes amid product price adjustments.

macro.why: NPCI's decision to delay MDR implementation on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali directly influences fee monetization for digital payment intermediaries.
Significant retroactive tax demands from GST authorities introduce balance sheet and cash flow uncertainties for midcap firms.

priced_in.text: Record Q2 sales volume growth of 13% YoY at APL Apollo Tubes following price increases.
Beat on pre-sales projections at Prestige Estates Projects with Q2 bookings reaching Rs 7,225 crore.

could_change.title: UPI Fee Framework Resolution
could_change.text: Clarification and rollout terms from NPCI regarding UPI P2M merchant discount rates following Diwali could alter revenue models.

could_change.title: Biosimilar Commercial Execution
could_change.text: Biocon's scheduled European launch of Pebrilzo in Q1 CY27 will test the commercial delivery of its Genentech settlement.

portfolio.risk_note: A combined 44.2% concentration across Financials and Industrials leaves the fund sensitive to credit cycle shifts, UPI regulatory decisions, and retrospective GST liabilities.
